ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails of recent fraud cases in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scandal and the phantom billing scheme.
questions: What are the financial connections between the different fraud cases?
How much money has been lost due to these schemes?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to identify patterns and connections between the different fraud cases and uncover new information about the perpetrators.
